item.title: Regulation of Anionic Redox Reaction Voltage by Energy Band Modulation for Li-Rich Cathodes
item.description:
با اصلاح کاتد غنی از لیتیوم توسط Li2S و تنظیم ساختار نواری، پلاتوی آنیونی کم‌ولتاژ و تله‌اندازی اکسیژن ایجاد شد که افت ولتاژ را به‌طور چشمگیری کاهش داد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using in situ electrochemical sulfur doping of a Li2S-modified Li-rich cathode to create a low-voltage anionic redox plateau via band modulation and oxygen trapping. This enables reversible S-involved charge compensation, achieving 99.6% Coulombic efficiency and markedly suppressed voltage decay (0.28 vs. 0.83 mV cycle⁻¹), offering mechanistic insight and design guidance for high-performance anionic-redox cathodes.
🏷 Li-rich cathode · anionic redox · voltage decay · sulfur doping · band modulation

item.title: Artificial Intelligence Advances the Uncovering of Solid–Liquid Interfaces in Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 💭 Perspective
💡 This perspective uniquely examines how AI can deepen understanding of complex, dynamic battery interfaces, standardize characterization, and guide interface material design. Its significance lies in highlighting AI’s potential to uncover new mechanisms and materials while critically addressing interpretability–accuracy trade-offs and researchers’ narrow cognitive risks, thereby advancing AI integration in battery interface research.
🏷 solid-liquid interface · artificial intelligence · battery interfaces · interpretability · interface design

item.title: Anion Sublattice Engineering Induced Niobium-Tungsten Oxide with Near-Zero Residual Strain for Stable 100 C Cycling Capability
item.description:
با مهندسی زیرشبکه آنیونی و ایجاد جای خالی اکسیژن در W3Nb14O44، آند اکسید نیوبیوم-تنگستن با کرنش پسماند نزدیک صفر و قابلیت شارژ سریع و دمای پایین ساخته شد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Anion-sublattice engineering introduces oxygen vacancies into W3Nb14O44, tuning electronic structure and Li+ kinetics. This yields near-zero residual strain, 77.4 mAh g–1 at 200 C, 72.6% retention over 6000 cycles at 100 C, and low-temperature operation down to –30 °C, offering a design strategy for fast-charging, durable niobium-oxide anodes.
🏷 Wadsley-Roth oxide · oxygen vacancies · fast-charging anode · low-temperature battery · near-zero strain
